featured_reviews.name: Priyamvadaa Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: This is going to be a long review. My fiancé and I started our ring shopping journey with our elders being against lab diamonds, but he and I wanted maximum joy without having to break the bank. I chose House of Quadri because I liked their premium feel and somehow their designs felt very luxurious and well made. I’m so, so glad I chose them. I had originally gone in not knowing what size or cut of diamond I wanted for myself. The first day, I told Karan and Trishna that I’m not looking to buy - I just wanted to try out different rings and see what spoke to me. They were extremely cooperative and Karan was giving me his own input too as to what designs are popular and trendy vs what might potentially look dated in a few years etc. That day I chose a 1.5ct oval diamond ring with a marquise bubble band. It was absolutely gorgeous and they did an engraving on it free of cost too. Karan gave me a date to come back on, and the ring was indeed ready for collection a day earlier than that. I collected the ring, brought it home, it was all good. However, as days went on I started to realise that I would’ve liked a slightly bigger stone, and a sturdier design because my lifestyle is active and I am rough on my hands. I was so nervous to reach out to Karan again about this because the sale had already been made! But I still did and goodness, he was so so helpful. He heard my concerns about the stone and at first told me all the reasons why I don’t need to feel pressured to upgrade. When I still expressed that I wanted to, he supported me and sourced the most beautiful stone for me. Not only that, but we then sat and redesigned my entire ring to suit my lifestyle and aesthetic details! I brought a design from the internet that I wanted and he got my ring entirely remade, charging me only for the making charges and nominally extra for the extra metal. What!!! I still cannot believe it. I’m a perfectionistic customer and it’s something I pride myself on. I don’t settle for mediocrity in my possessions and House of Quadri (specifically Karan) went above and BEYOND to meet my standards and expectations. The final ring was the ring of my DREAMS! I don’t even know who their kaarigars are, my ring had design elements that aren’t very common in engagement rings but their craftsmanship was FLAWLESS. Beyond the ring, I am also taken aback by Karan’s patience. I must’ve gone to the store 6-8 times I imagine, each time with some concern or something I wanted to change in the ring. And each time Karan was open and curious, never ever looking exhausted or impatient. When I finally received my final ring, I remember I started laughing in the store - because it was simply perfect. Whether he likes it or not, I’m now going to have Karan on speed-dial for all my jewellery needs, that’s for sure! Trishna is very sweet as well. Pics attached of the final ring. Half bezel, two-toned, with milgrain.
